mapper.select: SELECT I.ID, I.PARENT, I.CHILD, I.REQUESTER_ID, I.STATUS, P.NAME PARENT_NAME, C.NAME CHILD_NAME, R.NAME REQUESTER_NAME, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT FROM T_FAMILY_INVITE I LEFT JOIN T_USER P ON P.ID = I.PARENT LEFT JOIN T_USER C ON C.ID = I.CHILD LEFT JOIN T_USER R ON R.ID = I.REQUESTER_ID WHERE I.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND (I.PARENT = #{userId} OR I.CHILD = #{userId} OR I.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_FAMILY F WHERE F.CHILD = I.CHILD AND F.PARENT = #{userId})) ORDER BY I.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_FAMILY_INVITE(PARENT, CHILD, REQUESTER_ID, STATUS) VALUES (#{parent}, #{child}, #{requesterId}, 'PENDING')
